## Why

Three small changes put each part of the web app where it belongs, before its look is redesigned. They change what is on each page, not how it looks.

1. **The plan downloads should show what the coordinator sees.** Today "Download plan" saves the trip brief and the itinerary as JSON, with each place's name and address in place of its ID, and no route lines. "Download plan as stored" saves the same data as the database holds it, plus every stored fact about each place the plan links to. Neither one is the text the coordinator reads, so neither helps trace why the coordinator did something. The stored one shows little that the readable one doesn't.
2. **"Delete trip" belongs on the trips list,** next to each trip, not inside the trip. Deleting is about the trip as a whole, so it sits with the other trips, the way a file is deleted from its folder.
3. **The health line shrinks to the Phoenix check, on the trips list only.** Today, at the foot of every page, it says whether the API and the database can be reached, then whether turn traces reach Phoenix. The API and database part was there to show the pages worked. A problem there is plain anyway, since sign-in or the trip list fails. Whether traces reach Phoenix isn't plain, since the chat works the same either way and the traces are lost, so that part stays. Once is enough.

## Design

- [Functional spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/functional-spec.md), section 10.1 (the trip's sessions, "Delete trip", the health line, and the downloads).
- [Systems design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/systems.md), section 10 (the Phoenix check on the health line).
- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), section 2.1 (`read_itinerary`, and what a whole read gives).
- [Persistence](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/persistence.md), `readPlaces(tripId)`, which only the downloads use.

## Decided

Decided by Joe on 2026-10-27:

- **Two downloads, both text the coordinator could read, with no JSON download.** Each starts with what `read_trip_brief` returns, then the itinerary.
  - **"Download plan"** gives the itinerary exactly as `read_itinerary` returns it for the scope "all", the read the coordinator gets at the start of each session. Its stays and days are at the "slim" detail (`wholeLines()` in `src/tools/itinerary-lines.ts`).
  - **"Download full plan"** gives the same layout with every stay and day at the "full" detail, as a read scoped to a stay gives them: every candidate, with its rationale. The coordinator never gets the whole trip at this detail in one read, but each part matches what it sees when it reads that stay or stop.
  - **No size limit.** A whole read the coordinator asks for is refused when it's too large, but a download never is.
  - **A download saves nothing.** A read marks each check result new or already known. A download marks them the same way, but doesn't change what's saved, so the coordinator's next read is unchanged.
- **"Delete trip" moves to the trips list,** one control per trip, and leaves the trip's page. It still asks first, and it's still refused while a reply in one of the trip's sessions is coming in.
- **Only the Phoenix check stays, on the trips list only.** It says whether turn traces reach Phoenix, with the green check or red X. The words about the API and the database go. `/api/health` stays as it is, since the deploy calls it (systems design section 7), and the page still reads the Phoenix check from it.

## Open questions

- ~~Does the health line also show on the sign-in page?~~ Settled 2026-10-27 in chat with Joe: no. Only the Phoenix check is left, and traces matter only once the user is signed in and chatting.

## Do

- Replace the two JSON downloads with the two text downloads, in `src/api/plan-downloads.ts`, `src/api/plan-download-routes.ts`, and `web/src/plan-downloads.tsx`, reusing the functions `read_trip_brief` and `read_itinerary` use. Remove `readPlaces()` if nothing else uses it.
- Move "Delete trip" from the trip's page to the trips list, in `web/src/trip-page.tsx` and `web/src/home-page.tsx`.
- Cut the health line to the Phoenix check, and show it only on the trips list (`web/src/health-status.tsx` and where it's placed).
- Change functional spec 10.1 and systems design section 10 to match, and persistence design if `readPlaces()` goes.
- Add or change tests with fakes (DEVELOPMENT.md section 5), such as that "Download plan" gives the same text as a whole read.

## Done when

- In the browser, on the live site or locally: each download saves a text file, and "Download plan" matches what the coordinator's whole read returned in the session's trace. Each trip on the trips list has a delete control that asks first, and the trip's page has none. Only the trips list shows the Phoenix check, and no page shows the API and database line.
- `npm run check` passes.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** the PR.
